item.title: Northwind Labs releases Atlas 3 agent model with 128k context window
item.description: Northwind Labs said Atlas 3 scores 71.4 percent on the public agent benchmark and runs with a 128,000 token context window. The company said the model is available to developers on Tuesday. Pricing was not announced.

item.title: Atlas 3 launch: Northwind claims 71.4 percent on agent benchmark
item.description: Northwind Labs announced Atlas 3 on Tuesday. The company said the model reached 71.4 percent on the public agent benchmark. Independent evaluations of the model have not yet been published.

item.title: Developers get access to Northwind's Atlas 3 agent model
item.description: Atlas 3 became available to developers on Tuesday, Northwind Labs said. Two researchers who tested an early build said latency improved noticeably over the previous release. Northwind declined to share training data details.

item.title: Northwind Labs releases Atlas 3 agent model with 128k context window
item.description: Northwind Labs said Atlas 3 scores 71.4 percent on the public agent benchmark and runs with a 128,000 token context window. The company said the model is available to developers on Tuesday. Pricing was not announced.

item.title: Northwind's Atlas 3 agent benchmark score disputed by analysts
item.description: Two analysts said Atlas 3 does not score 71.4 percent on the public agent benchmark, putting the comparable figure closer to 64 percent. Northwind Labs said its methodology is documented in the Atlas 3 model card.

item.title: Kestrel Institute publishes open-weight 12B model under a research licence
item.description: The Kestrel Institute released a 12-billion-parameter model with open weights under a research-only licence. The institute said commercial use requires a separate agreement. Evaluation results were published alongside the release.

item.title: Kestrel's 12B open-weight release comes with research-only terms
item.description: Kestrel's release includes weights and evaluation results but restricts commercial use. Two developers said the licence would keep them from deploying the model in products.

item.title: Open-weight model releases accelerate as Kestrel joins with 12B system
item.description: Kestrel Institute's release is the fourth open-weight model published this month. The institute said it trained the system on 1.4 trillion tokens.

item.title: Labour board opens inquiry into automated screening at three employers
item.description: The labour board said it opened an inquiry into automated candidate screening at three employers after complaints were filed in June. The employers said their systems are reviewed by human recruiters.

item.title: Employers defend automated screening as labour board inquiry begins
item.description: Two of the three employers named in the inquiry said human recruiters review every rejection. The labour board declined to say when it expects to conclude.
